descriptionByLocale.en:
Amstein + Walthert is an engineering company with around 1,000 employees. As engineers, planners and consultants, we work on all aspects of the engineering of civil engineering throughout the entire life cycle. Our solutions are innovative, thoughtful and sustainable. Amstein + Walthert Bern AG offers a comprehensive overall planning offer in the areas of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, cooling, sanitary, electrical, automation and fire protection. In the area of building automation, we plan innovative and complex automation solutions for demanding large-scale projects with a wide range of uses – from hospitals, schools and universities to industrial, administrative and commercial buildings to infrastructure projects, cultural buildings, sports facilities, residential facilities and data centers throughout Switzerland. Do you feel addressed? Do you live building automation, appreciate complex challenges and want to work at the highest professional level? Then we look for you. In our newly created area at the beginning of the year, you will take over as an ambitious project manager: responsible for exciting (large-scale) projects – with a lot of room for manoeuvre, real development opportunities and the opportunity to actively shape the area. These are your tasks in the future:
• Lead and coordinate versatile automation projects throughout Switzerland independently – from planning to handover
• If you advise our customers expertly, develop concepts and evaluate solutions holistically
• Control interfaces during implementation and ensure a smooth implementation
• Are you the reliable contact person for project-related questions – internally and externally
• Convince our customers with competence and promote internal cooperation through your integrity and impact You will ideally bring the following background:
• In-depth experience in the planning and/or execution of automation projects from the field to the control system level
• Technical training at the level of HF/TS, FH/HTL or equivalent practical experience
• Pragmatic, solution-oriented and quality-conscious working method
• Professional, winning appearance and confident communication style also in demanding customer contact
• Combination of personal responsibility and team orientation
• Networked thinking and curiosity

descriptionByLocale.it:
Amstein + Walthert è una società di ingegneria con circa 1.000 dipendenti. Come ingegneri, progettisti e consulenti, lavoriamo su tutti gli aspetti dell'ingegneria civile in tutto il ciclo di vita. Le nostre soluzioni sono innovative, riflessive e sostenibili. Amstein + Walthert Bern AG offre una completa offerta di pianificazione generale nelle aree di riscaldamento, ventilazione, aria condizionata, raffreddamento, sanitari, elettrico, automazione e protezione antincendio. Nell'ambito dell'automazione degli edifici, pianifichiamo soluzioni di automazione innovative e complesse per impegnativi progetti su larga scala con una vasta gamma di utilizzi – da ospedali, scuole e università a edifici industriali, amministrativi e commerciali a progetti infrastrutturali, edifici culturali, impianti sportivi, strutture residenziali e data center in tutta la Svizzera. Ti senti indirizzato? Vivi l'automazione della costruzione, apprezzi le sfide complesse e vuoi lavorare al massimo livello professionale? Allora ti cerchiamo. Nella nostra nuova area creata all'inizio dell'anno, si prende il sopravvento come un team leader ambizioso: responsabile di progetti entusiasmanti (grandi) – con un sacco di spazio per manovra, opportunità di sviluppo reali e l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente la zona. Questi sono i vostri compiti in futuro:
• Progetti complessi di automazione su larga scala in tutta la Svizzera – dalla pianificazione alla consegna;
• Assicurare la qualità all'interno della zona attraverso la corrispondenza, i controlli dei documenti e i chiari fattori di successo
• Se si agisce come riferimento professionale, promuovere il trasferimento di conoscenze e sviluppare standard ulteriormente
• Interfacce di controllo sovranamente e coordinare tutte le parti interessate pertinenti
• Sei la nostra persona di contatto affidabile per domande tecnicamente complesse
• Convincere i nostri clienti con competenza e promuovere la cooperazione interna attraverso la vostra integrità e impatto
• Diversi anni e profonda esperienza nella progettazione e realizzazione di progetti di automazione degli edifici dal campo al livello del sistema di controllo
• Prima o più anni di esperienza manageriale e piacere nella promozione e nello sviluppo dei dipendenti
• Formazione tecnica a livello HF/TS, FH/HTL
• Un metodo di lavoro pragmatico, orientato alla soluzione e consapevole della qualità
• Un aspetto professionale, vincente e uno stile di comunicazione sicuro, anche nel contatto con i clienti esigenti
• La capacità di combinare la responsabilità personale e l'orientamento del team in modo efficace
descriptionByLocale.en:
Amstein + Walthert is an engineering company with around 1,000 employees. As engineers, planners and consultants, we work on all aspects of the engineering of civil engineering throughout the entire life cycle. Our solutions are innovative, thoughtful and sustainable. Amstein + Walthert Bern AG offers a comprehensive overall planning offer in the areas of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, cooling, sanitary, electrical, automation and fire protection. In the area of building automation, we plan innovative and complex automation solutions for demanding large-scale projects with a wide range of uses – from hospitals, schools and universities to industrial, administrative and commercial buildings to infrastructure projects, cultural buildings, sports facilities, residential facilities and data centers throughout Switzerland. Do you feel addressed? Do you live building automation, appreciate complex challenges and want to work at the highest professional level? Then we look for you. In our newly created area at the beginning of the year, you take over as an ambitious team leader: responsible for exciting (large-scale) projects – with a lot of room for manoeuvre, real development opportunities and the opportunity to actively shape the area. These are your tasks in the future:
• Lead and coordinate complex (large-scale) automation projects throughout Switzerland – from planning to handover;
• Ensure quality within the area through correspondence, document checks and clear success factors
• If you act as a professional reference, promote knowledge transfer and develop standards further
• Control interfaces sovereignly and coordinate all relevant stakeholders
• Are you our reliable contact person for technically complex questions
• Convince our customers with competence and promote internal cooperation through your integrity and impact
• Several years and profound experience in the planning and execution of building automation projects from the field to the control system level
• First or several years of management experience and pleasure in promoting and developing employees
• Technical training at level HF/TS, FH/HTL
• A pragmatic, solution-oriented and quality-conscious working method
• A professional, winning appearance and a confident communication style, even in demanding customer contact
• The ability to combine personal responsibility and team orientation effectively
descriptionByLocale.de:
Amstein + Walthert ist ein Ingenieurunternehmen mit rund 1’000 Mitarbeitenden. Als Ingenieur:innen, Planer:innen und Consultants bearbeiten wir sämtliche Aspekte der Technik von Hoch- und Tiefbauten über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg. Unsere Lösungen sind innovativ, durchdacht und nachhaltig. Die Amstein + Walthert Bern AG bietet ein umfassendes Gesamtplanungsangebot in den Bereichen Heizung, Lüftung, Klima, Kälte, Sanitär, Elektro, Automation und Brandschutz. Im Bereich Gebäudeautomation planen wir innovative und komplexe Automationslösungen für anspruchsvolle Grossprojekte mit unterschiedlichsten Nutzungen – von Spitälern, Schulen und Universitäten über Industrie-, Verwaltungs- und Gewerbebauten bis hin zu Infrastrukturprojekten, Kulturbauten, Sportstätten, Wohnanlagen und Rechenzentren in der ganzen Schweiz. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Du lebst Gebäudeautomation, schätzt komplexe Herausforderungen und willst auf höchstem fachlichem Niveau arbeiten? Dann suchen wir genau dich. In unserem Anfang Jahr neu geschaffenen Bereich übernimmst du als ambitionierte:r Teamleiter:in Verantwortung für spannende (Gross-)Projekte – mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, echten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und der Chance, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Das sind deine Aufgaben In Zukunft:
• Leitest und koordinierst du komplexe (Gross-)Automationsprojekte in der ganzen Schweiz – von der Planung bis zur Übergabe;
• Sicherst du die Qualität innerhalb des Bereichs durch Koreferate, Dokumentenprüfungen und klare Erfolgsfaktoren
• Wirkst du als fachliche Referenz, treibst den Wissenstransfer voran und entwickelst Standards weiter
• Steuerst du Schnittstellen souverän und koordinierst alle relevanten Anspruchsgruppen
• Bist du unsere verlässliche Ansprechperson für fachlich komplexe Fragestellungen
• Überzeugst du unsere Kundschaft durch Kompetenz und förderst die interne Zusammenarbeit durch deine Integrität und Wirkung Das bringst du mit
• Mehrjährige und fundierte Erfahrung in der Planung und Ausführung von Gebäudeautomationsprojekten von der Feld- bis zur Leitsystemebene
• Erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende zu fördern und weiterzuentwickeln
• Technische Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/TS, FH/HTL
• Eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise
• Einen professionellen, gewinnenden Auftritt und einen souveränen Kommunikationsstil, auch im anspruchsvollen Kundenkontakt
• Die Fähigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Teamorientierung wirkungsvoll zu verbinden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Amstein + Walthert est une entreprise d'ingénierie avec environ 1000 employés. En tant qu'ingénieurs, planificateurs et consultants, nous travaillons sur tous les aspects du génie civil tout au long du cycle de vie. Nos solutions sont innovantes, réfléchies et durables. Amstein + Walthert Bern AG offre une offre de planification globale complète dans les domaines du chauffage, de la ventilation, de la climatisation, du refroidissement, des sanitaires, de l'électricité, de l'automatisation et de la protection contre l'incendie. Dans le domaine de l'automatisation des bâtiments, nous planifions des solutions d'automatisation innovantes et complexes pour exiger des projets à grande échelle avec un large éventail d'utilisations - des hôpitaux, écoles et universités aux bâtiments industriels, administratifs et commerciaux aux projets d'infrastructure, bâtiments culturels, installations sportives, installations résidentielles et data centers partout en Suisse. Vous sentez-vous adressé ? Vivez-vous l'automatisation des bâtiments, appréciez les défis complexes et souhaitez travailler au plus haut niveau professionnel? Alors on te cherche. Dans notre zone nouvellement créée au début de l'année, vous prenez le relais en tant que chef d'équipe ambitieux : responsable de projets passionnants (de grande envergure) avec beaucoup de marge de manœuvre, de réelles opportunités de développement et la possibilité de façonner activement la zone. Ce sont vos tâches futures:
• Diriger et coordonner des projets d'automatisation complexes (à grande échelle) dans toute la Suisse – de la planification au transfert;
• Assurer la qualité dans la région par la correspondance, la vérification des documents et des facteurs de succès clairs
• Si vous faites office de référence professionnelle, favorisez le transfert de connaissances et développez des normes plus poussées.
• Interfaces de contrôle souverainement et coordination de toutes les parties prenantes concernées
• Êtes-vous notre personne de contact fiable pour des questions techniquement complexes
• Convaincre nos clients avec compétence et promouvoir la coopération interne par votre intégrité et votre impact
• Plusieurs années et une expérience profonde dans la planification et l'exécution de projets d'automatisation des bâtiments du terrain au niveau du système de contrôle
• Première ou plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion et plaisir à promouvoir et à développer les employés
• Formation technique au niveau HF/TS, FH/HTL
• Une méthode de travail pragmatique, orientée vers la solution et soucieuse de la qualité
• Une apparence professionnelle, gagnante et un style de communication confiant, même dans un contact client exigeant
• La capacité de combiner efficacement la responsabilité personnelle et l'orientation de l'équipe
